snippet.title: Sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - E3 2021 Teaser - Nintendo Direct
snippet.description:
Return to Hyrule - and the skies above - in this first look at gameplay for the Sequel to the Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, planned for release on Nintendo Switch in 2022. Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-legend-of-zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom-switch/
